system.description:
You know the proper way to greet someone, when to rise, how to make introductions and how to hold a toast, keeping your cool in any social scenario from high tea to a gang's rally.

Etiquette can be used with Social Tests to impress or blend in at gatherings. If you make a social faux pas, you may immediately expend an Etiquette Ability to negate the gaffe — your character knew better than to make the mistake.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
